Year 2: Multimedia skills and ethics
Year 3: Internships and beat selection
Year 4: Portfolio, specialisation, and job search
Career: Reporter → Senior Correspondent → Editor
topRecruiters: Digital Outlets (Scroll, The Print, The Quint)
journalism-mass-comm.salaryDirection: Starting: ₹3-5 LPA | Mid-career: ₹8-15 LPA | Senior: ₹25 LPA+ (editors / anchors / senior leaders). Pay varies widely across print, TV, and digital; figures are approximate.
higherEd: PG Diploma IIMC / ACJ / Asian College of Journalism
risks: Job insecurity and layoffs in media
actionPlan: Publish consistently from Year 1
Learn video, audio, and data skills
Build a strong, searchable portfolio
Network with editors and reporters
Specialise in a beat (business, politics, sports, tech)

digital-media-content.whyFits: Digital Media fits you because you love creating and experimenting, and want to turn ideas into content that grows an audience.
digital-media-content.entryRoute: Class 12 (any stream) → B.A. in Mass Communication / Digital Media / BBA with digital specialisation → or direct start by building a channel and portfolio.
projects: Launch a niche YouTube / Instagram / podcast channel
Produce a 30-day content calendar and track growth
Edit a mini-documentary
Run a collaboration with a local brand
Build a newsletter with 100+ subscribers
digital-media-content.internshipStrategy: Work with agencies and creator teams as editor or strategist. Keep a public, measurable record of your content performance.
skillMilestones: Year 1: Find your niche and create daily
Year 2: Learn editing, SEO, and analytics
Year 3: First collaborations and monetisation
Year 4: Scale or specialise (editor / strategist / producer)
Career: Creator / content lead / channel manager
digital-media-content.salaryDirection: Starting: ₹2.5-5 LPA (job) / variable (creator) | Mid-career: ₹6-15 LPA | Senior: ₹20 LPA+ (content head / successful creator-entrepreneur). Creator income is highly variable and not guaranteed; figures are approximate.
risks: Platform algorithm changes can hurt reach
actionPlan: Pick a niche and publish consistently
Learn editing and analytics
Build skills beyond one platform
Keep a stable fallback income early
Understand contracts and copyright basics

advertising-pr.whyFits: Advertising and PR fit you because you enjoy ideas, persuasion, and storytelling — and you work well under tight deadlines and team pressure.
advertising-pr.entryRoute: Class 12 (any stream) → BA / BBA in Advertising, Public Relations, or Mass Communication (Symbiosis, Christ, MICA PG later) → agency or in-house roles.
projects: Create a full ad campaign (print + digital) for a local brand
Write a press release and media outreach plan
Plan and execute a college fest or event with sponsors
Handle a mock crisis communication scenario
Build a creative portfolio on Behance / Notion
advertising-pr.internshipStrategy: Agency internships (creative, accounts, or PR) are the entry path. Build a portfolio with real briefs and measurable results.
skillMilestones: Year 1: Communication and creativity basics
Year 2: Copywriting and media planning
Year 3: Agency internship and campaign pitch
Year 4: Portfolio and specialisation
Career: Executive → Manager → Creative Director / PR Head
advertising-pr.salaryDirection: Starting: ₹3-5 LPA | Mid-career: ₹8-18 LPA | Senior: ₹25 LPA+ (creative director / agency leadership). Agency pay varies; figures are approximate.
futureTrends: Reputation management in social media era
risks: Long hours and high pressure at agencies
Creative work is competitive and subjective
actionPlan: Build a portfolio from Year 1
Intern at both agency and brand sides
Learn data and analytics basics
Pitch real ideas to small businesses
Network at advertising and PR events

film-tv-production.whyFits: Film fits you because you think in images and stories, and you are ready for the grind of building your craft from assistant level up.
film-tv-production.entryRoute: Class 12 (any stream) → B.A. / B.Sc. in Film Production / Mass Communication; institutes such as FTII, SRFTI, Whistling Woods, MICA via entrance exams (JET / institute tests).
projects: Write and shoot a 5-minute short film
Edit a documentary on a local subject
Create a showreel in your specialisation
Submit your work to student film festivals
Plan a micro-budget production schedule
film-tv-production.internshipStrategy: Work as an assistant on sets, in post-production, or at production houses. Your showreel and network matter more than grades.
skillMilestones: Year 1: Storytelling and camera fundamentals
Year 2: Short films in each role
Year 3: Specialise and assist on professional sets
Year 4: Thesis film and showreel
Career: Assistant → Department Head → Director / DOP / Editor
film-tv-production.salaryDirection: Starting: ₹2-4 LPA (assistant level; freelance varies) | Mid-career: ₹6-15 LPA | Senior: ₹30 LPA+ (varies widely; top creatives much higher). Film income is highly irregular; figures are approximate.
higherEd: M.A. / PG Diploma in Film Direction / Editing / Cinematography
futureTrends: Virtual production and LED volume stages
risks: Success often depends on networks and persistence
actionPlan: Shoot something every month
Assist on professional sets early
Build a clear specialisation
Submit to festivals and labs
Maintain a side income or fallback skill

fine-arts.whyFits: Fine Arts fits you because you express yourself visually and want to build a practice, a voice, and a body of work.
fine-arts.entryRoute: Class 12 (any stream) → B.F.A. (entrance at JJ School of Art, Faculty of Fine Arts - MSU Baroda, Delhi College of Art, Santiniketan, Chitrakala Parishad, CUET-UG in some universities) → M.F.A.
projects: Hold a solo or group exhibition
Illustrate a book or zine
Complete a mural in a public space
Build an online portfolio and sell prints
Create an artist statement and gallery proposal
fine-arts.internshipStrategy: Intern at galleries, studios, art fairs, or museums. Participate in group shows, residencies, and open calls.
skillMilestones: Year 1: Drawing and fundamentals
Year 2: Medium specialisation
Year 3: Voice and exhibition practice
Year 4: Thesis show and professional portfolio
Career: Practice + teaching / commissions / curation
fine-arts.salaryDirection: Starting: ₹2-4 LPA (employed) / irregular (practising artist) | Mid-career: ₹5-12 LPA | Senior: ₹20 LPA+ (established artists / art directors / curators). Art income depends on sales, commissions, and reputation; figures are approximate.
futureTrends: Digital and NFT / online art markets
risks: Needs financial planning and parallel streams
actionPlan: Build a consistent portfolio
Participate in exhibitions from Year 2
Learn digital tools too
Diversify income (teaching / commissions / design)
Keep documentation and pricing records

graphic-visual-design.whyFits: Graphic Design fits you because you notice details, enjoy composition, and want to communicate through clear, beautiful visuals.
graphic-visual-design.entryRoute: Class 12 (any stream) → B.Des (NID DAT, UCEED / IIT-IDC, NIFT DAT, Symbiosis SID, Pearl, MIT-ID) or BFA / B.Sc. Design.
projects: Create a complete brand identity for a local business
Design a magazine or book cover series
Build a poster series for a social cause
Design product packaging with mock-ups
Present a rebranding case study
graphic-visual-design.internshipStrategy: Intern at design studios and agencies. Maintain a Behance / Dribbble portfolio with 6-8 strong case studies.
skillMilestones: Year 1: Fundamentals and software
Year 2: Typography and identity
Year 3: Internships and live briefs
Year 4: Thesis and portfolio
Career: Designer → Senior Designer → Art Director / Creative Director
graphic-visual-design.salaryDirection: Starting: ₹3-6 LPA | Mid-career: ₹8-18 LPA | Senior: ₹25 LPA+ (creative directors / studio heads). Studio, agency, and freelance pay differ; figures are approximate.
risks: Highly visual competition and portfolio dependency
AI tools may automate routine design
actionPlan: Build 6-8 deep portfolio case studies
Master typography and layout
Learn motion graphics basics
Prepare early for NID / UCEED
Keep sketching and exploring daily

ux-ui-design.whyFits: UX / UI fits you because you like understanding people and shaping digital products that are easy and delightful to use.
ux-ui-design.entryRoute: Class 12 (any stream) → B.Des / B.Sc. Design / BCA / B.A. + UX specialisation (NID DAT, UCEED, MIT-ID) → UX bootcamps or M.Des (HCI).
projects: Redesign an existing app with user-research evidence
Conduct 10 usability tests and report findings
Build a complete design system in Figma
Design an accessible interface for older users
Create an end-to-end case study for your portfolio
ux-ui-design.internshipStrategy: Seek UX internships at startups, product companies, and design studios. Show process (research → insights → design → test), not just screens.
skillMilestones: Year 1: Design basics and Figma
Year 2: Research and wireframing
Year 3: Internship and live product projects
Year 4: Case studies and specialisation
Career: Designer → Senior → Design Lead / Head of Design
ux-ui-design.salaryDirection: Starting: ₹5-9 LPA | Mid-career: ₹15-30 LPA | Senior: ₹40 LPA+ (design leadership). Product companies tend to pay more; figures are approximate.
higherEd: M.Des. in HCI / Interaction Design (IIT, NID)
risks: Portfolio quality matters more than degree
actionPlan: Learn Figma and prototyping deeply
Build 3-4 case studies with real research
Study psychology and product thinking
Get a UX internship early
Learn HTML / CSS basics to talk to developers

animation-vfx-gaming.whyFits: Animation and VFX fits you because you want to create worlds, characters, and effects, and are prepared to learn both art and technical tools.
animation-vfx-gaming.entryRoute: Class 12 (any stream) → B.Des / B.Sc. Animation & VFX / B.A. Animation (NID, UCEED, Arena, MAAC, Whistling Woods, Symbiosis) → studio entry via showreel.
projects: Create a 30-second 3D animated short
Build a character rig and animate a walk cycle
Produce a VFX shot breakdown for a portfolio
Design and prototype a small game level
Make a complete showreel with 3-5 pieces
animation-vfx-gaming.internshipStrategy: Join studios as intern / trainee artist. Your showreel decides your job — ensure it is short, polished, and role-specific.
skillMilestones: Year 1: Drawing, principles, and software basics
Year 2: 3D modelling and animation
Year 3: Specialise (animation / VFX / game art) and internship
Year 4: Showreel and placements
Career: Junior Artist → Senior → Supervisor / Lead
animation-vfx-gaming.salaryDirection: Starting: ₹3-6 LPA | Mid-career: ₹8-20 LPA | Senior: ₹30 LPA+ (supervisors / lead artists). Studio, game, and freelance roles differ; figures are approximate.
futureTrends: OTT and gaming growth in India
actionPlan: Learn Blender first (free), then specialise
Build a showreel by Year 3
Pick one pipeline role early
Participate in game jams and challenges
Stay updated with real-time engines

interior-design.whyFits: Interior Design fits you because you love space, colour, and materials, and enjoy turning client needs into functional, beautiful environments.
interior-design.entryRoute: Class 12 (any stream) → B.Des (Interior Design) / B.A. / B.Sc. Interior Design (NID, NIFT, Pearl, Symbiosis, CEPT, state colleges) via NATA / DAT / institute entrance.
projects: Design a 2BHK apartment with full drawings and renders
Redesign a small cafe or boutique
Create a materials and finishes board
Prepare a cost estimate for an interior project
Complete a live site project with a real client
interior-design.internshipStrategy: Intern at interior design firms and architecture studios. Visit sites and learn vendors, materials, and execution — design is only half the job.
skillMilestones: Year 1: Design basics and drafting
Year 2: Space planning and 3D software
Year 3: Studio projects and internship
Year 4: Thesis and portfolio
Career: Designer → Senior → Studio Head / Own Practice
interior-design.salaryDirection: Starting: ₹3-5 LPA | Mid-career: ₹8-18 LPA | Senior: ₹25 LPA+ (studio owner / senior designer). Own practice income depends on clients; figures are approximate.
risks: Site execution delays and cost pressures
actionPlan: Master AutoCAD and SketchUp early
Build real project portfolio
Visit sites and learn execution
Understand costing and vendors
Market yourself online with case studies

architecture.whyFits: Architecture fits you because you can imagine spaces, enjoy both drawing and technical logic, and want to design buildings that shape how people live.
architecture.entryRoute: Class 12 with Mathematics → B.Arch (5 years) via JEE Main Paper 2 / NATA; Council of Architecture (CoA) registration required to practise.
projects: Design a sustainable house for a hot-dry climate
Measure and document a heritage building
Create a parametric facade in Grasshopper
Prepare a complete working drawing set
Produce a final-year design thesis
architecture.internshipStrategy: Practical training under a registered architect is mandatory — choose firms with diverse projects. Build a strong portfolio and learn BIM early.
skillMilestones: Year 1: Drawing, studio basics, and model making
Year 2: Design, construction, and software
Year 3: Studios, services, and practical training
Year 4: Urban design and professional practice
Year 5: Thesis and portfolio; Career: Intern → Architect → Principal / Partner
topRecruiters: Architecture Firms (Morphogenesis, Studio Lotus, Sanjay Puri)
architecture.salaryDirection: Starting: ₹3-6 LPA | Mid-career: ₹8-20 LPA | Senior: ₹30 LPA+ (principal / partner). Early salaries can be modest; own practice varies widely; figures are approximate.
risks: Long study hours and low early pay
actionPlan: Prepare for NATA / JEE Paper 2 early
Build sketching and model-making skills
Learn Revit and Rhino
Do internships with diverse firms
Plan Master's or own-practice route by final year

performing-arts-music.whyFits: Performing Arts fits you because you are driven to perform and create, and you are ready to invest years in craft, practice, and performance.
performing-arts-music.entryRoute: Class 12 (any stream) → B.A. / B.P.A. / B.Mus in Music, Dance, or Theatre (Sangeet Natak Akademi-linked institutes, NSD, FTII, University departments, Gandharva Mahavidyalaya) → performance / teaching.
projects: Perform a full recital or stage production
Record and release an EP / dance video
Compose or choreograph an original piece
Teach a beginner workshop series
Build a performing arts promotion plan
performing-arts-music.internshipStrategy: Perform consistently — college events, festivals, local shows, and online releases. Build a network with other artists and producers.
skillMilestones: Year 1: Technique and discipline
Year 2: Repertoire and performance experience
Year 3: Original work and teaching
Year 4: Recital, portfolio, and professional launch
Career: Performer / teacher / producer / arts manager
performing-arts-music.salaryDirection: Starting: ₹1.5-4 LPA (employed) / project-based (freelance) | Mid-career: ₹5-12 LPA | Senior: ₹20 LPA+ (established performers / producers). Income is irregular and depends on gigs and reputation; figures are approximate.
higherEd: M.A. / M.P.A. in Music / Dance / Theatre
risks: Needs a business mindset beyond art
actionPlan: Practise daily and perform often
Build online presence and recordings
Learn music production / marketing basics
Diversify (teaching, session work, events)
Network with producers, directors, and festival curators

law-llb.whyFits: Law fits you because you reason precisely, enjoy argument and writing, and want to work with rules that shape business, rights, and justice.
law-llb.entryRoute: Class 12 (any stream) → 5-year integrated BA LLB / BBA LLB via CLAT, AILET, LSAT-India, or university entrance (NLUs, Symbiosis, Jindal), or 3-year LLB after any graduation. Bar Council of India enrolment is required to practise.

items: Clinical Legal Education / Moot Court / Dissertation

projects: Participate in moot court competitions
Draft contracts, notices, and petitions as practice
Prepare a legal research memo on a recent Supreme Court case
Work in a legal aid clinic
Write and publish an article in a law journal
law-llb.internshipStrategy: Do at least one internship each year — district court, High Court, law firm, in-house team, NGO. Build a mix of litigation and corporate exposure before specialising.
skillMilestones: Year 1: Foundations and legal writing
Year 2: Procedural laws and moot courts
Year 3: Internships and specialisation direction
Year 4-5: Dissertation, advanced electives, and placements / judiciary preparation
Career: Associate → Senior Associate → Partner / Senior Advocate
law-llb.salaryDirection: Starting: ₹3-6 LPA (litigation / smaller firms) | ₹10-20 LPA (top corporate firms) | Mid-career: ₹12-35 LPA | Senior: ₹40 LPA+ (partners / senior advocates; very variable). Litigation income can start low and grow with reputation; figures are approximate.
futureTrends: Legal tech and AI in research
risks: Litigation income is slow to build
NLU / top-college admission competition is intense
actionPlan: Prepare for CLAT / AILET early
Internship every year
Build writing and public speaking
Pick a specialisation by Year 3
Plan judiciary vs firm vs litigation path deliberately

corporate-ip-law.whyFits: Corporate, IP, and Tech Law fits you because you prefer business deals, innovation, and drafting over courtroom drama, and want to advise companies and founders.
corporate-ip-law.entryRoute: Class 12 (any stream) → BA LLB / BBA LLB / LLB with specialisation electives → LL.M. in Corporate / IP / Technology Law; patent agent exam (for science students) for IP route.
projects: Draft a shareholders' agreement for a hypothetical startup
Prepare a trademark search and registration strategy
Write a data-protection compliance note for an app
Mock due diligence for an acquisition
Analyse a recent patent dispute
corporate-ip-law.internshipStrategy: Target corporate law firms, IP boutiques, and in-house teams at tech companies. Build drafting samples and a portfolio of mini-memos.
skillMilestones: Year 1: Core law and drafting
Year 2: Commercial and company law
Year 3: IP / tech electives and first corporate internship
Year 4-5: Specialisation and placements
Career: Associate → Counsel → Partner / General Counsel
corporate-ip-law.salaryDirection: Starting: ₹8-18 LPA | Mid-career: ₹20-45 LPA | Senior: ₹50 LPA+ (partners / GCs; highly variable). Top-tier firms pay more; figures are approximate.
risks: Needs strong commercial and tech understanding
actionPlan: Build drafting skills early
Understand business and finance basics
Follow regulatory developments (SEBI / MeitY)
Intern at firm + in-house to compare
Consider LL.M. or IP certification by Year 4-5

civil-services.whyFits: Civil Services fits you because you want to serve at scale, are ready for long-term preparation, and care about governance and public good.
civil-services.entryRoute: Any bachelor's degree (any stream) → UPSC Civil Services Examination (Prelims, Mains, Interview) → training at LBSNAA / SVPNPA / IFS Academy. State PSC exams for state services.

items: Choose a degree subject that you enjoy and can score in
Read NCERT History, Geography, Polity, Economy (Class 6-12)

projects: Write one answer a day on current issues
Make concise notes for revision across all subjects
Practise essay writing weekly
Take full-length Prelims mocks
Analyse previous years' papers to find patterns
civil-services.internshipStrategy: There is no formal internship, but gain exposure through voluntary work, RTI practice, NGO / government internships, or local administration projects. Maintain a strong backup option.
skillMilestones: Year 1: Degree + NCERT basics + newspaper habit
Year 2: Core subjects and optional selection
Year 3: Test series and Prelims attempt (optional)
Year 4+: Mains, interview, and repeated attempts if needed
Career: Officer → District / Departmental Head → Secretary-level roles
civil-services.salaryDirection: Starting: As per government pay scales (Level 10 pay matrix plus allowances; approx. ₹10-15 LPA equivalent in total benefits) | Mid-career: Rises through seniority and posting | Senior: Cabinet Secretary / Secretary-level roles carry the highest government pay scales. Pay is fixed by central pay commissions; benefits and perks are significant. Figures are approximate.
higherEd: Policy and Public Administration Masters (IIM / TISS)
State PSC and other central service exams as backups
risks: Very low success rate; many attempts may be needed
High opportunity cost of preparation years
Needs a solid backup plan (degree + skills + alternative exams)
actionPlan: Choose a degree you can score well in
Build newspaper reading and note-making habits
Understand the exam stages and syllabus early
Keep a realistic backup plan
Prioritise health, sleep, and mental balance during preparation

defence-services.whyFits: Defence services fit you because you value discipline, courage, and leadership, and want a career built on service and team spirit.
defence-services.entryRoute: Class 12 → NDA / NA exam (UPSC; Army wing open to any stream, Air Force & Navy need Physics & Maths) → training at NDA; or graduate entry via CDS, AFCAT, or Technical Graduate Course (TGC); Territorial Army and others.
projects: Maintain a fitness plan and track progress weekly
Practise SSB tests (psychological, GTO, interview) in mock groups
Lead small team projects or sports events
Study current affairs and defence news daily
Complete NCC training if available
defence-services.internshipStrategy: NCC (A / B / C certificates) is the best early exposure. Prepare for SSB interviews by building real leadership experience in college, sports, and community projects.
skillMilestones: Year 1: Fitness and basics
Year 2: Leadership and current affairs
Year 3: SSB preparation and selection exams
Year 4: Training academy / pre-commission
Career: Lieutenant → Captain → Major → senior command roles
topRecruiters: Paramilitary Forces (CRPF / BSF via UPSC CAPF)
defence-services.salaryDirection: Starting: As per defence pay matrix: approx. ₹10-15 LPA total emoluments at commissioning with allowances (varies) | Mid-career: Rises with rank, appointment, and allowances | Senior: Senior ranks carry high-level pay scales and benefits. Defence pay and perks follow government scales; figures are approximate and not guaranteed.
higherEd: Defence Staff College / Higher Command Courses
Second-career options after retirement (security, PSU, consulting)
actionPlan: Build fitness and discipline early
Join NCC / sports
Prepare for SSB with real leadership experience
Understand exam routes (NDA / CDS / AFCAT)
Keep a backup academic path

public-policy-governance.whyFits: Public Policy fits you because you like analysing problems with evidence and designing solutions that can scale to millions.
public-policy-governance.entryRoute: Class 12 (any stream) → B.A. / B.Sc. in Economics, Political Science, or Public Policy (Ashoka, Azim Premji, Jindal, TISS) → Master's in Public Policy (TISS, IIT, Ashoka, abroad).
projects: Write a policy brief on a local governance challenge
Evaluate an existing government scheme using data
Conduct a small field survey and analyse results
Build a data dashboard of district indicators
Prepare an RTI-based accountability report
public-policy-governance.internshipStrategy: Internships and fellowships (Young India Fellowship, Prime Minister's Rural Development Fellows, state fellowships) are key entry points.
skillMilestones: Year 1: Core policy and economics
Year 2: Methods and data skills
Year 3: Internships and applied policy projects
Year 4: Capstone, fellowship, and Masters planning
Career: Analyst → Associate → Policy Lead / Advisor
public-policy-governance.salaryDirection: Starting: ₹4-8 LPA | Mid-career: ₹10-22 LPA | Senior: ₹30 LPA+ (policy leadership / international organisations). Sector and institution strongly influence pay; figures are approximate.
higherEd: Master's in Public Policy (MPP) — TISS, IIT, Ashoka, abroad
risks: Pay and job structure vary widely
Academic or policy careers need Master's degrees
actionPlan: Learn R / Stata / Python for policy data
Write regularly (briefs, op-eds)
Apply for fellowships early
Specialise in one sector (health / climate / education / urban)
Build a network in think tanks and government

criminology-forensic.whyFits: Criminology and Forensics fit you because you are observant and logical, and you want to use science and evidence to uncover truth.
criminology-forensic.entryRoute: Class 12 (Science preferred for forensic science; any stream for criminology) → B.Sc. Forensic Science / B.A. Criminology (NFSU, Amity, Christ, Delhi University) → M.Sc. / M.A. for specialisation.
projects: Process a mock crime scene with documentation
Analyse fingerprints and document samples
Perform a basic digital forensic image analysis
Write an expert witness report for a mock case
Study crime patterns in a city using public data
criminology-forensic.internshipStrategy: Intern at State Forensic Science Laboratories, cyber crime cells, and private forensic firms. Report writing and chain-of-custody discipline matter as much as lab skills.
skillMilestones: Year 1: Science and criminology foundations
Year 2: Core forensic techniques
Year 3: Lab practicum and internship
Year 4: Specialisation and dissertation
Career: Scientific Assistant → Senior Scientific Officer → Lab Director
criminology-forensic.salaryDirection: Starting: ₹3-6 LPA | Mid-career: ₹8-15 LPA | Senior: ₹20 LPA+ (lab directors / senior investigators / consultants). Government roles follow pay scales; private consultancy varies; figures are approximate.
risks: Portrayal in media vs reality gap
Government posts are limited and exam-driven
Emotional load of exposure to crime scenes
actionPlan: Choose an institute with lab facilities and police / FSL links
Strengthen chemistry / biology fundamentals
Learn digital forensics tools
Practise report writing and testimony
Prepare for state and central forensic recruitment exams

mbbs.whyFits: Medicine fits you because you are driven to understand the human body, comfortable with responsibility, and ready for a very long training path.
mbbs.entryRoute: Class 12 (Physics, Chemistry, Biology) → NEET-UG → MBBS (about 5.5 years including a compulsory 1-year internship) → NEET-PG / INI-CET for MD / MS specialisation. NMC registration is required to practise.
projects: Maintain a clinical case log with learning points
Complete community health survey projects
Present case studies in departmental seminars
Participate in research (ICMR STS) as a student
Volunteer in health camps and outreach programmes
mbbs.internshipStrategy: Clinical postings and internship are your core training. Seek electives and research exposure in a specialty early; plan PG preparation alongside clinical learning.
skillMilestones: Year 1: Pre-clinical foundations
Years 2-3: Para-clinical subjects and early clinical exposure
Year 4: Core clinical rotations
Year 5: Final subjects and compulsory internship
Career: MBBS → PG (3 years) → Super-specialty → Consultant
mbbs.salaryDirection: Starting: ₹6-12 LPA (MBBS medical officer; stipend during internship/PG is lower) | Mid-career: ₹15-40 LPA (specialist) | Senior: ₹50 LPA+ (senior consultants / surgeons; highly variable). Public vs private pay differs; figures are approximate.
higherEd: MD / MS (Medicine / Surgery / Paediatrics / Radiology etc.)
risks: Very competitive entry (NEET) and long training period
actionPlan: Build strong NCERT-based biology, chemistry, and physics foundations
Prepare for NEET with disciplined routine
Protect mental and physical health
Explore specialties during MBBS
Plan NEET-PG / INI-CET preparation from the final years

dental-bds.whyFits: Dentistry fits you because you like precise hands-on work, enjoy helping people with visible results, and may want to run your own clinic.
dental-bds.entryRoute: Class 12 (PCB) → NEET-UG → BDS (5 years including a 1-year internship) → MDS (NEET-MDS) for specialisation. Dental Council of India (NMC-linked regulations) registration to practise.
projects: Complete clinical case logs across specialties
Create a community oral health awareness camp
Perform simulated procedures on phantom heads
Present a case study of a complex dental treatment
Design a basic dental clinic business plan
dental-bds.internshipStrategy: Dental internship and college clinic rotations are essential. Observe private practitioners and specialty clinics to understand business and patient management.
skillMilestones: Year 1: Basic sciences and dental materials
Year 2: Pre-clinical and clinical foundation
Year 3: Core dental subjects and clinical practice
Year 4: Advanced clinics, then 1-year internship
Career: BDS → Practice / MDS → Specialist / Clinic owner
topRecruiters: Private Dental Clinics (Clove, Apollo White Dental)
dental-bds.salaryDirection: Starting: ₹3-6 LPA | Mid-career: ₹8-20 LPA | Senior: ₹30 LPA+ (established clinic owners / specialists). Clinic income depends on location and patient base; figures are approximate.
risks: Many dental graduates compete for limited clinic spaces
actionPlan: Strengthen hand-skills and clinical confidence
Do internships in diverse clinics
Learn digital dentistry skills
Plan MDS or clinic setup by Year 4
Build communication and patient-handling skills

ayush.whyFits: AYUSH fits you because you value holistic, traditional approaches to health and want to combine classical knowledge with modern clinical practice.
ayush.entryRoute: Class 12 (PCB) → NEET-UG → BAMS / BHMS / BUMS / BNYS (about 5.5 years including internship) → MD / MS (AYUSH) or practice. State AYUSH councils regulate registration.

items: Basic Principles of the Chosen System

coreSubjects: Basic Principles of the Chosen System
projects: Prepare a treatment plan for a chronic lifestyle condition (supervised)
Document herbal formulations with identification and uses
Run a wellness awareness camp
Conduct a small observational study
Create a patient education guide
ayush.internshipStrategy: Internship in AYUSH hospitals and integrative clinics. Learn to communicate evidence and limits clearly — integrity with patients matters most.
skillMilestones: Year 1-2: Foundations and basic sciences
Year 3: Pre-clinical and clinical subjects
Year 4: Clinical postings
Year 5: Final subjects and internship
Career: Practitioner → MD (AYUSH) → Clinical / Research / Wellness leader
